findings.cause: Extra paragraph separator caused by marker-only paragraph continuation in documentary parallel row, not missing text.
locations: documentary_parallel/print.xml: morning_entrance_verses Psalm5:8 row includes full verse p followed by p(part=first) containing bare verse/chapter terminators and chapter55 marker only.
documentary_parallel/book.tex:1370–1379 contains full English verse continuously, followed by \par\skipnumbering\OSKeepSep\par and empty vno/chapter marks.
reledmac.xslt:3410–3417 emits f:para-break after completed p; numbered-stream2591–2639 turns it into an explicit blank separator while single-pstart is active.
findings.classification: Visible gap is not an intentional source paragraph with prayer words. Full English verse text remains continuous in generated TeX; the reported intraverse visual location is not a literal split before “before Thy holy place”. Marker-only trailing paragraph causes gratuitous blank-line geometry.
findings.recommendation: Suppress paragraph-separation glue when the following paragraph contribution in this alignment fragment has only nonvisual milestone/bookkeeping leaves. Preserve those markers and their order, and preserve real paragraph separators between actual text/rubrics. Do not delete source scope terminators or wrap each verse differently to work around exporter spacing.
tests: Synthetic parallel row: text paragraph followed by marker-only next-paragraph prefix must retain marker commands but no OSKeepSep.
Control with two actual prose paragraphs must retain separator and line-count alignment.
Control with page-only carrier must retain facs navigation/anchor and not become a blank numbered paragraph.

findings.cause: Completely empty compiled parallel rows are serialized into styled HTML grids; mobile col-parallel border/padding makes visible divider lines.
locations: electronic.xml in expanded/documentary_parallel: p:parallel with two self-closing p:parallelItem, no descendant markers/IDs/page links/conditions.
html.xslt:664–688 emits par and both col-empty divs even for literally empty row.
reader.css:133–156 grids plus row-gap and secondary padding-bottom/border-bottom.
findings.recommendation: Smallest robust output fix: suppress strictly empty parallel rows at HTML transform (both items contain no nodes except whitespace and no target-bearing attributes anywhere), or omit empty carriers during final compiler cleanup. For a general zero-word carrier retain anchors/page/conditional/graphic semantics and remove only layout chrome. Never discard based solely on normalize-space(.) or .col-empty: those also mark semantically necessary anchor/page/image-only carriers.
tests: Two truly empty cells emit no styled par row.
Marker-only xml:id/corresp target survives as zero-height anchor.
Page-only carrier retains unique source link.
Textless graphic, note/rubric, and undecided conditional cases survive.
Known condition false in both languages may collapse chrome while preserving target nodes.

findings.cause: Adjacent foreign spans lack separators and bidi isolation; existing source colons combine across RTL/LTR spans.
locations: expanded/book.html unresolved Shabbat rubric: foreign(he)בשבת immediately adjacent to foreign(en)On Shabbat.
reader.css has rubric color but no bilingual label separator/isolation rule.
findings.recommendation: Prefer shared semantic bilingual-label rendering with explicit separator and each language isolated (bdi or unicode-bidi:isolate). Preserve documentary punctuation inside language spans; insert a space or stable separator between spans rather than deleting source colons. Do not apply globally to all adjacent foreign spans since some intentionally join inline words.
tests: RTL label plus LTR label appears separated on desktop/mobile.
Colon-bearing source label retains its own punctuation without visually doubled boundary colons.
Ordinary inline foreign text remains unchanged.
